correctness.rationale: For each n>=3, the n! Hamiltonian path facets partition into (n-1)! disjoint n-facet supports. Oriented boundaries of the formally missing n-arc cycle simplices are primitive integral kernel vectors. Every consecutive (n-2)-arc face has exactly two top cofaces, which force each block coefficient vector to be their common unique integral multiple; no n-1 chains exist. Stabilizer C_n acts with sign (-1)^{n-1}, so integral induced module follows. Trivial/sign multiplicities are (1,1) for odd n and (0,1) for even n, yielding A_n invariants 2/1. Standalone finite integer boundary and full permutation trace checks n=3..6 reproduced.

value.rationale: This canonically resolves a previously unreported precise integral invariant and full natural symmetry lattice for an established infinite family central to symmetric-homology constructions. The cyclic-order basis and parity jump of top homology of quotient complexes are structural results unavailable from the previously published connectivity bounds or Euler sums, and allow exact top-degree computations without building a large boundary matrix.
